SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.delete_flag, r.role_type, r.description, p.id as perm_id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.resource, p.action, p.description as perm_description FROM roles r
WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.delete_flag, r.role_type, r.description, p.id as perm_id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.resource, p.action, p.description as perm_description FROM roles r
WHERE r.delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} ORDER BY r.role_type, r.role_code

SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.deleted_at, r.delete_flag, r.role_type, r.description, p.id as perm_id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.resource, p.action, p.description as perm_description FROM roles r
